attributes.title: [FinOps] Spend vs savings
attributes.description: Complete AWS bill (LINKED_ACCOUNT unblended) vs identified, captured, and parked monthly savings. SERVICE table is a slice, not a second total. Never add identified and captured. Default last 30 days.

**Spend** is Cost Explorer **LINKED_ACCOUNT** unblended — the complete bill for the time picker (default 30 days). Do **not** add it to the SERVICE table; that is the same dollars sliced by product and is incomplete when a line has no service.

**Identified** = open + in progress, **monthly** run-rate. **Captured** = done (`realized_savings`). **Parked** = hidden, not in identified. Never add identified and captured. Opportunity ≈ identified ÷ trailing spend.
